mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fd_finance_category_change_log (id, finance_category_id, change_time, operator, field_name, field_label, old_value, new_value, tenant_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{financeCategoryId}, #{changeTime}, #{operator}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldLabel}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{scopedTenantId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, finance_category_id, change_time, operator, field_name, field_label, old_value, new_value, tenant_id FROM fd_finance_category_change_log WHERE IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND finance_category_id = #{financeCategoryId} and tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 ORDER BY change_time DESC
